entries.reason: every resource of this port is CPU-resident already, a buffer being its own bytes and a texture an OpenGL ES 2.0 texture the port reads and writes on the CPU, so there is no residency to move between
entries.effect: the call returns and the resource is left as it is, and the log says so once the first time; the API asks for a performance and not for a value, and the performance is the one it asks for (facts/Metal/Blits.md)
entries.source: SDK 26.2, Metal, MTLBlitCommandEncoder.h; the access hints have no observable result in Metal either
